question: What should the CyberAlchemy product-ontology owner do with the exact D65-S2 Product Capability and product-ontology candidate?

options.label: Admit exact D65-S2 candidate
options.effect: Admit the exact-hash Product Capability and product ontology for this integration epoch, pass G-D65-PRODUCT, and make D65-S3 eligible for separate authoring.
non_effects: does not promote any integration-local definition into canonical definitions
does not author or admit the D65-S3 business ontology
does not authorize DomainSpec source, compilation, Rust implementation, migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, or external effects

options.label: Request bounded amendment
options.effect: Keep G-D65-PRODUCT blocked and return the exact candidate for a named product-meaning amendment.
options.required_input: Name the node, relation, outcome, rule, owner lane, or boundary to amend.

options.label: Defer admission
options.effect: Preserve the candidate and evidence without admission; D65-S2 remains blocked and D65-S3 remains not_evaluable.

options.label: Stop this successor route
options.effect: Reject continuation from this candidate and require a newly scoped product route before any replacement is authored.

claim_ceiling: This request presents an exact candidate and admissible owner choices. It does not itself admit, adopt, implement, migrate, cut over, publish, release, deploy, or create external effects.
